summary: Made Craze & Crash's long video L-20261125-31, 'Pizza Hut Was the King. How Domino's Took the Crown' (16:47, 8 chapters, business war), told from Domino's, Yum and Yum China 10-Ks plus Restaurant Dive, Fox Business, TIME and the Deseret News, and shipped it for the next long slot.
why: state --format long said video (1 of 3 long videos this week). Scout's feed led with the owner's pin 1, 2026-11-20-pizza-hut-dominos (usable now); its ending, Yum's $2.7B sale, closed on 7 Aug and 1 Sep 2026.

findings.title: Fact review: failed twice, passed on round three
findings.detail: Round one named 9 problems: Patrick Doyle was head of Domino's US business, not yet CEO, in the 2009 ads; the sign said Pizza Hut, not the Carneys' name; 1997 was not sourced as the peak; a box-tracker line had no source; a misleading worldwide 'gap'; 'from both companies' own filings' overstated the sourcing; 'Domino's copied it' and a 'STOLEN CROWN' stamp implied wrongdoing; Papa John's share claim; a wrong source chip. Round two: a 'the peak' count label and a CEO paraphrase shown as a quote. All fixed. 61 sourced facts, all confirmed; the 55 new ones are added to the topic in research/topics.json (historical counts marked fixed).

findings.title: QA: two rounds on the stills, then one wasted full re-render
findings.detail: Round one (12 items) and round two (8 items) on the stills were all fixed. Studio then added two tags to clear the motion gate without checking them on a still, and a QA look at the finished mp4 found them stacked wrongly (deal-split read 'Yum China Capital'), which cost a second ~90-minute render. Owner, 25 Nov: QA happens on stills only, the video is rendered once everything is correct, and it ships as soon as it renders. Studio followed that for the ship; the rule belongs in agents/studio.md (protected, owner only).

findings.title: For the improver: doc chapters never reach render.json
findings.detail: renderer/remotion.py counts only scene=='chapter' beats as chapters, so a doc long video's 8 chapter beats (beat key `chapter`) give render.json just 'Intro'. Studio wrote the chapter times into the description by hand from timeline.json. Fix: also count doc beats carrying `chapter`.

findings.title: For the improver: the doc motion gate counts the time after the last event
findings.detail: Long spoken figures ('nineteen thousand nine hundred and seventy-four') open 3+ s gaps between words; Studio needed four full renders to clear the 3 s gate. A helper that adds a moment on a word inside each gap (from the voice timings) before the render would save a render each time.

findings.title: No footage again
findings.detail: Pexels/Pixabay keys are still missing; the film is photos (Commons, about 120 different ones), 22 real 10-K pages with the line highlighted, typeset filings, headlines, count-ups, splits, maps and timelines.
